messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> Elevated 5xx and timeouts for inference-us-east-1. Alert ID INC-20260317-001. Spike started ~3209876500.
oncall-emma: I'm on it. acking pager. gathering details.
infra-andy: Seeing segfaults in model-runner pods on g4dn-pool-3. OOM then gateway 502/504s.
runtime-nikhil: paste logs? stack traces?
infra-andy: ```
[kernel] oom_kill_process: Killed process 8423 (model-runner) total-vm:...
runtime: segfault at 0x7fff... RIP: 0x55aa12abcc
kv_cache: allocate failed: out_of_memory
```
infra-andy: also kvcache alloc spikes on long prefix traffic, growth to 1.2GB before failure.
oncall-emma: customer impact?
customer-ops-lee: CS reports tenants tc-761 and tc-233 seeing 502s/timeouts since 11:08 UTC. Escalating.
product-alex: status page? any public note needed?
oncall-emma: not yet, want mitigation first.
runtime-nikhil: immediate mitigation suggestion: reroute traffic for model `redwood/opt-v2` -> fallback `redwood/opt-v2-q8` in us-east-1 to reduce kvcache pressure. Also consider scaling runner pool.
runtime-nikhil: example control-plane call:```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/reroute \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-v2","fallback":"redwood/opt-v2-q8","region":"us-east-1"}'
```
infra-andy: scaling up pool as temp relief:```bash
kubectl -n infer scale deployment/model-runner-g4dn --replicas=12
```
deploy-bot: Rolling restart job started for deployment/model-runner-g4dn (desired 12). job_id=JOB-3209
oncall-emma: applying reroute now.
oncall-emma: reroute applied, control-plane 200 OK. seeing 5xx drop in last 2m from ~30% -> ~6%.
customer-ops-lee: drafting CS messages to impacted tenants; will post once confirmed reduced errors.
product-alex: draft status: "Degraded service in inference-us-east-1; fallback models enabled; mitigation in progress; investigating root cause."
runtime-nikhil: quick deep-dive: suspect recent quant-kernel commit changed memory accounting for kvcache under long prefixes. reproducing with load test locally.
infra-andy: reproduction: sending 1k requests with 30k prefix tokens triggers repeated mmap and eventually SIGSEGV in runner.
oncall-emma: hotfix options?
runtime-nikhil: hotpatch plan: pin kernel selection to previous commit on live nodes and restart runtime process:```bash
echo 'kernel_commit=abc123prev' > /etc/runtime/config
systemctl restart runtime.service
```
infra-andy: applied hotpatch to 3 nodes in pool-3. monitoring.
oncall-emma: 5xx trending down to ~1.2% after reroute+restarts.
customer-ops-lee: CS updated tc-761, tc-233 and a small batch of affected tenants. Slack threads and email sent.
product-alex: status page updated with mitigation note.
runtime-nikhil: saved core dumps + runtime logs: `tar czf /tmp/segfault-3209876543.tgz /var/log/runtime/*` then uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/3209876543`.
infra-andy: note for postmortem: no enforcement of kvcache hard limit after kernel change. add regression test for prefix-heavy workloads.
oncall-emma: creating incident record INC-20260317-001, assigning PM @product-alex and SRE lead @infra-andy.
product-alex: will own customer comms and rollout plan for a safe revert or patch.
oncall-emma: closing pager for primary mitigation. monitoring and tracking for RCA. will hand off to night oncall in 30m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-001 status: mitigated -> monitoring. current 5xx: 0.9% (5m window). Handoff to night oncall in 30m.
sre-ryan: I'll pick this up for nightshift. thanks all.
end of thread.
